model_scope: Linearized thermal response about the frozen bridge equilibrium; not a thermomechanical constitutive hysteresis model
tau_source: User-approved public simulation assumptions, not measured bridge parameters
dummy_reason: Rigid dummy connectors represent kinematic connections, not independently expanding physical members
synthetic_side: model Y=-21.5 m; not an independently verified upstream sensor mapping
sensor_interpolation: Piecewise linear interpolation between adjacent original upper-chord nodes at the seven main-span fractions
noise_source: Independent Gaussian observation noise, public simulation assumptions
future_mechanical_memory: Two first-order thermal states; no added BW state and no neural generator
thermal_field: Girder and cable uniform group temperatures; hanger nodal temperatures linearly interpolate by height; towers/piers/other nodes remain at zero temperature increment
temperature_parameter_source: Rounded first annual/daily harmonic amplitude and phase from D1 training-only observed temperature statistics; no measured sequences used by the public generator
parameter_update_scope: Four harmonic parameters only; baseline, stochastic innovations, weather AR(1), thermal response, noise, seed, sampling and splits unchanged
inherited_fe_validation_scope: D2 coefficient basis checks retained; new D2.1 actual cold/warm trace extremes independently checked in data/extreme_validation.json. No all-field error bound.
